Title: Scaffold monorepo
Description: Create service folders, contribution rules and boundaries.
Outputs: apps/*; pipeline/; db/; deploy/; tests/; README.md; CONTRIBUTING.md
Acceptance criteria: Tree uses TRD names; branch/PR/commit convention documented; each service has README; no parallel /web tree.

Title: Pin toolchain and quality tools
Description: Pin language, dependencies, base images, formatter, linter, type checker and pre-commit.
Outputs: pyproject.toml; uv.lock; apps/dashboard/package.json and lock; .pre-commit-config.yaml; Docker image pins
Acceptance criteria: Clean install uses Python 3.12.9/Node 20; tools and base image pins verified; quality checks pass.

Title: Add secrets policy and CI
Description: Add safe config loading, env example, CI lint/test/build/security scans.
Acceptance criteria: CI runs lint, unit tests, dashboard build and scans; missing required secret fails startup.

Title: Resolve paths, architecture and TRL baseline
Description: Document canonical repository naming, boundaries and evidence-based readiness baseline.
Acceptance criteria: Paths use TRD names; readiness is evidence-based or explicitly not assessed; reviewer/target rationale recorded.

Title: Review prototype and driver prior art
Description: Inspect PPT prototype link and search for LUT camera-driver source.
Acceptance criteria: Record 404 dated 2026-11-19 and LUT code not found; request source; make no reuse claim without inspection.

Title: Plan datasets and annotation
Description: Inventory permissible datasets/models, annotations, privacy, checksum and offline cache.
Inputs: PRD/TRD model scope; PPT-32; PPT-39; PPT-43
Outputs: docs/DATASET_AND_ANNOTATION_PLAN.md; models_registry/README.md; Roboflow checklist; download/checksum script
Acceptance criteria: Inventory approved person/vehicle, plate, face, IR/thermal and Roboflow sources; record license/privacy/labels/checksum/cache; block unapproved assets.
Offline-safe?: Partial; manifests offline, acquire approved assets later

Title: Validate Timescale schema
Description: Run baseline schema on PostgreSQL 16/TimescaleDB and verify key/policy behavior.
Acceptance criteria: Disposable clean DB applies schema; hypertable keys, FK, index, retention behavior recorded; failure blocks merge.
Offline-safe?: No DB binary now; use pinned local Compose

Title: Create Alembic baseline and seed
Description: Add reversible migration baseline and idempotent synthetic local seed.
Acceptance criteria: Empty DB upgrade and restore/downgrade procedure pass; seed is repeatable and contains synthetic records only.

Title: Implement authentication lifecycle
Description: Implement login, refresh, logout, privileged MFA, password hashing and session revocation.
Acceptance criteria: 15-minute access token; privileged access blocked until MFA; invalid/replayed/expired refresh rejected and audited.

Title: Enforce RBAC and site scope
Description: Implement PRD role permissions and per-site authorization.
Outputs: authorization policy service; permission matrix tests
Acceptance criteria: Allow/deny tests cover six PRD roles; cross-site read/write is denied.

Title: Implement P0 camera/zone contracts
Description: Implement canonical camera/zone APIs and site-scoped fields.
Acceptance criteria: API-003..010 and FR-007 behavior pass contract tests; no speculative site/rule routes; OpenAPI snapshot passes.

Title: Add audit and local hash chain
Description: Record immutable actions and implement chain verification.
Acceptance criteria: Login/config/alert/evidence access records actor/purpose/resource/time; changed or broken chain fails verification.

Title: Add health and metrics
Description: Implement health/readiness endpoints, structured correlated logs and Prometheus metrics.
Acceptance criteria: Readiness truthfully checks DB; request/event/camera/node IDs correlated; dependency outage is degraded, not success.

Title: Implement user/role API and resolve route gaps
Description: Implement PRD user/role lifecycle and document missing site/rule CRUD contract.
Inputs: PRD API-026/027; FR-007; WEB_FLOW GAP-01..27; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: API-026/027 passes scoped RBAC tests; site/rule CRUD remains blocked pending approved PRD/TRD contract.

Title: Define driver and demo sources
Description: Create camera source protocol and deterministic file/optional phone-stream adapters.
Acceptance criteria: File/phone adapters share timestamped-frame interface; fixtures verify shape/order/time; phone not required for offline demo.

Title: Add RTSP and ONVIF adapters
Description: Implement RTSP source plus ONVIF discovery/PTZ adapter and test doubles.
Acceptance criteria: Mock tests cover discovery/auth/PTZ failures; compatibility claim names tested devices/profiles.
Offline-safe?: Partial; fixtures and mock if camera unavailable

Title: Add reconnect and bounded capture
Description: Implement heartbeat, reconnect/backoff, bounded drop-oldest queue and metrics.
Acceptance criteria: Queue bounded; jittered 2–30s backoff; offline after 10s; recovery after 3 valid frames; analytics target defaults to 12 FPS.

Title: Implement preprocessing and compatibility matrix
Description: Add resize/denoise/low-light pipeline and camera codec/profile record.
Acceptance criteria: Fixtures preserve timing/dimensions; compatibility list labels each profile tested or untested.

Title: Add class-aware detector adapter
Description: Integrate person/vehicle model adapter and suppress non-target classes.
Outputs: pipeline/inference/; optional vehicle_type.py; model config; fixture tests
Acceptance criteria: Shared schema; ROI <25%, short edge <16px, confidence .40 and NMS IoU .55 defaults tested; optional vehicle-type classifier is config-gated; animals/shadows cannot alert; license recorded.
Offline-safe?: Yes with cached approved weights or labeled mock

Title: Add ByteTrack and DeepSORT adapters
Description: Make tracker selectable while keeping stable tracking contract.
Acceptance criteria: Fixture IDs are stable; switching tracker is configuration-only; no cross-camera re-ID claim.

Title: Confirm tracks and persist trajectories
Description: Add configurable multi-frame confirmation and timestamped track persistence.
Inputs: PRD FR-014/017; TR-TRK-001; schema; PPT-23; PPT-43
Acceptance criteria: Default 3-frame confirm, 30-frame expiry, 2–10 override and 300s trajectory retention pass tests.

Title: Add registry and model export tools
Description: Add model metadata/signature check and PyTorch-to-ONNX/TensorRT scripts.
Acceptance criteria: Load verifies hash/signature; export report names runtime/hardware; missing GPU reports actionable limitation.
Offline-safe?: ONNX CPU fallback; TensorRT needs GPU

Title: Implement fence geometry and foot point
Description: Add line/polygon collision, direction, and bbox bottom-centre reference point.
Acceptance criteria: Depth-independent fixtures pass; invalid/self-intersecting polygons rejected.

Title: Version fence schedules and calibration
Description: Support direction, class allowlist, active schedule and calibration version.
Acceptance criteria: Schedule/direction/class/version honored; events reference exact fence version.

Title: Import Roboflow/COCO polygons
Description: Safely import valid polygon exports and reject invalid payloads.
Acceptance criteria: Valid fixtures import; malformed, excessive or out-of-range data returns field errors without partial writes.

Title: Add rule interface and fence events
Description: Create plugin API and persist explainable intrusion events.
Acceptance criteria: Anomaly includes category, explanation, track and rule version; normal activity does not alert.

Title: Implement alert state machine
Description: Add dedupe, cooldown, assignment, lifecycle transitions and escalation.
Acceptance criteria: Severity enum, 30s default cooldown, dedupe, valid/invalid transitions, high escalation at 60s, critical at 30s, audit pass.

Title: Publish WebSocket and broker events
Description: Add authorized WebSocket delivery and MQTT/Redis adapter.
Acceptance criteria: Site-scoped ordered envelope; sequence-gap REST resync; local mode works without broker.

Title: Add signed webhooks and siren abstraction
Description: Implement HMAC signing, retry/DLQ, and opt-in relay/siren hook.
Acceptance criteria: Signature/retry/DLQ pass; siren requires authorized role/approval, 3s timeout and enabled relay; mock explicit.
Offline-safe?: Yes; mock siren and local receiver

Title: Capture event snapshot and pre/post clip
Description: Add event-triggered annotated snapshot/clip from bounded ring buffer.
Inputs: PRD FR-080/081; TR-EVID-001; schema; PPT-29; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Annotated snapshot and 10s pre/post clip or exact failure reason; manifest/checksum saved; storage failure explicit.

Title: Implement event search and geo response
Description: Add filtered/paginated event search with supported geo/evidence fields.
Inputs: PRD FR-082, API-011/012; schema; PPT-24; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Camera/time/class/plate/zone/severity/status filters paginate; detail returns present explanation/evidence/geo only.

Title: Add plate localization adapter
Description: Implement plate detector adapter and labeled crop fixtures.
Acceptance criteria: Boxes/confidence meet fixture tolerance; low-quality plate yields no read.
Offline-safe?: Yes with approved cached model or labeled mock

Title: Add plate correction, segmentation and OCR
Description: Implement perspective correction, segmentation, OCR adapter and character scores.
Acceptance criteria: OCR returns per-character confidence; absent engine fails explicitly.

Title: Add state validation and frame fusion
Description: Validate state-wise Indian plate syntax and fuse 3-5 frame observations.
Acceptance criteria: Known state fixtures pass/reject; fusion reports source-frame count and disagreement.

Title: Persist ANPR and measure latency
Description: Add read/watchlist APIs and benchmark exact-match/latency.
Acceptance criteria: p50/p95 and accuracy recorded on named hardware/data; <100ms stays a target until measured.
Offline-safe?: Yes; report CPU result if no GPU

Title: Implement loiter and toward-fence rules
Description: Add explainable dwell-time and trajectory-vector plugins.
Acceptance criteria: Defaults: dwell 30s; approach 2m/5s/45deg; reason records values, thresholds, track and rule version.

Title: Implement speed and group heuristics
Description: Add speed anomaly and group-clustering/movement rules.
Acceptance criteria: Test 5s smoothing > mean+3 MAD; groups >=4/5m/10s and >=3 aligned tracks/>.80/10s; no unvalidated crowd claim.

Title: Implement abandoned-object heuristic
Description: Add owner-track loss and static-object duration rule.
Acceptance criteria: Default 300s after owner expires; cancellation tested; operator feedback required and uncertainty shown.

Title: Add feedback export and action stub
Description: Export reviewed false positives and expose explicit action-recognition stub.
Acceptance criteria: Export is access-controlled; crawling/climbing reports not configured, never fake detection.

Title: Gate FRS on privacy and licensing
Description: Document legal basis, model license, purpose and retention approvals.
Acceptance criteria: Approver, purpose, retention, access, basis and licenses documented; absent approval disables FRS.

Title: Add face detector/alignment quality adapter
Description: Implement detection, alignment, quality and rejection interface.
Acceptance criteria: Test >=64x64 face, confidence >=.60, five landmarks, 112x112 crop; low quality/occlusion/pose rejected/scored; no identity claim.

Title: Encrypt embeddings and add FAISS adapter
Description: Implement encrypted vector storage and rebuildable local index.
Acceptance criteria: 512 float32 L2-normalized vector, cosine rank and threshold calibration tested; encrypted and absent from logs/API.

Title: Add governed watchlist and review API
Description: Implement feature-gated watchlist and human match review with audit.
Acceptance criteria: Site scope, purpose, expiry, reviewer and audit tests pass; no autonomous enforcement.

Title: Implement day/night selector
Description: Add schedule, brightness and IR-state mode with hysteresis/manual override.
Acceptance criteria: Test default <25 lux-equivalent or luminance percentile <18; schedule/IR override and hysteresis; reason logged.

Title: Select visible versus IR model
Description: Implement camera capability/model registry selection and degraded fallback.
Acceptance criteria: Selection deterministic; missing IR weights explicitly degrade, no silent visible fallback.

Title: Evaluate night and thermal conditions
Description: Run separate dawn/dusk/IR/thermal tests and publish caveats.
Acceptance criteria: Sensor/condition-specific results; no thermal claim without sensor and footage.

Title: Scaffold React dashboard
Description: Build route shell, tokens, localization and error boundaries.
Inputs: TRD; WEB_FLOW parts 1-2; design docs; PPT-31/32
Acceptance criteria: Routes map to WEB_FLOW screen IDs; language switch and error/offline pages; lint/build pass.

Title: Implement auth, site and role navigation
Description: Build login/session/site selection and permission-aware navigation.
Inputs: PRD roles; auth API; WEB_FLOW; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Browser tests cover login/logout/expiry and forbidden routes; server remains authorization authority.

Title: Build live camera and overlay view
Description: Wire cameras, stream state, health, WebSocket overlay and stale-data display.
Inputs: WEB_FLOW live screens; UI-002; camera/WS API; PPT-21; PPT-29
Acceptance criteria: All states shown; freshness visible; measure <=2s on named 16-tile rig or report target unmet; no invented stream endpoint.

Title: Build alert inbox and lifecycle controls
Description: Implement list/detail, acknowledge, assign, resolve and escalate flows.
Inputs: WEB_FLOW alert flow; UI-003; TRD APIs; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Role matrix enforced; failed mutation rolls back; severity text/icon/color; measured task <=4 primary clicks.

Title: Build events, evidence and verification pages
Description: Implement searchable event/evidence views and integrity report display.
Inputs: WEB_FLOW evidence; PRD FR-083/085; schema/API; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Filters shareable; integrity shown; signed link <=15min and rechecks authorization; result links to chain report.

Title: Build remaining dashboard screens
Description: Build GIS, fence, analytics, devices, models, admin, audit, settings and help screens.
Inputs: WEB_FLOW SCR-08..25; design docs; API gaps; PPT-24; PPT-25; PPT-32
Acceptance criteria: Every SCR-01..25 has route/state or explicit blocked/read-only contract; offline map and keyboard fence editor; unsupported controls disabled.

Title: Publish OpenAPI contract
Description: Document API version, auth, errors, idempotency, rate limits and examples.
Acceptance criteria: Contract snapshot passes; breaking change fails compatibility check.

Title: Build local C2/SOC mock receiver
Description: Demonstrate signed webhook delivery, replay protection and idempotency.
Acceptance criteria: Receiver verifies HMAC and records one delivery per idempotency key; no external endpoint needed.

Title: Define VMS/C4I interoperability adapters
Description: Set adapter boundaries and protocol coverage matrix.
Acceptance criteria: Every interface labeled tested/simulated/unsupported/pending; no universal compatibility claim.

Title: Test open-format portability
Description: Round-trip model metadata, GeoJSON fences and event JSON exports.
Acceptance criteria: Round-trip succeeds without proprietary account or opaque format.

Title: Implement ordered idempotent sync
Description: Add durable outbox, cursor, resume and conflict visibility.
Acceptance criteria: Interrupted retry creates no duplicates; per-node order resumes; conflicts are visible.

Title: Add priority sync and bandwidth metrics
Description: Prioritize alert metadata and measure bytes/quality per transfer.
Acceptance criteria: Critical events precede clips; bytes/quality recorded; reduction not claimed before measurement.

Title: Add degraded CPU fallback and watchdog
Description: Handle GPU failure, smaller model/CPU mode and bounded restarts.
Acceptance criteria: GPU failure keeps services alive in fallback or explicitly unavailable; restart loop bounded.

Title: Package Compose and systemd services
Description: Create NUC/Jetson deployment profiles and unattended restart configuration.
Acceptance criteria: Health checks/restart tested on available host; Jetson untested unless hardware test recorded.

Title: Create STRIDE threat model
Description: Map trust boundaries, threats, mitigations, tests and residual risks.
Acceptance criteria: Includes SSRF/RTSP credential, API, model/supply-chain, storage and physical edge threats.

Title: Encrypt evidence and manage keys
Description: Implement envelope encryption and key references/rotation procedure.
Outputs: encryption service; MinIO config; key runbook
Acceptance criteria: Ciphertext unreadable without authorized key; secrets absent from source/logs; rotation procedure tested.

Title: Harden API transport and controls
Description: Add TLS policy, security headers, rate limits, CORS allowlist and audit hooks.
Acceptance criteria: Negative tests prove header, origin, rate and audit behavior.

Title: Verify hash chain and signed ledger
Description: Implement evidence verify endpoint, audit chain and Merkle block validation.
Acceptance criteria: Valid, tampered, missing-link and bad-signature cases distinguished; external chain off by default.

Title: Add artifact provenance and security scans
Description: Pin SBOM/dependencies, verify model signatures and gate scans.
Acceptance criteria: CI detects altered weights and disallowed dependency/license; exceptions have owner/expiry.
Offline-safe?: Partial; offline scan with staged feeds

Title: Build deterministic test pyramid
Description: Create unit, integration, API, pipeline and browser suites with fixtures.
Acceptance criteria: CI separates suites; core rule/auth/hash target coverage tracked; exceptions documented.

Title: Measure detector and alert quality
Description: Evaluate precision/recall, FP/FN and latency with documented labels.
Acceptance criteria: Dataset split, labels, thresholds and confusion matrix recorded; 97%@30FPS remains third-party target.

Title: Measure system and ANPR performance
Description: Record FPS, stage/camera-to-dashboard latency, bandwidth and resource use.
Acceptance criteria: p50/p95 and hardware/software versions recorded; PPT values labeled target until reproduced.

Title: Run robustness and chaos tests
Description: Exercise weather/lighting fixtures, camera/network/GPU/DB failures.
Acceptance criteria: Report recovery time, missed/duplicate alerts across named conditions/failures.

Title: Test feedback and hot model swap
Description: Verify false-positive export, retraining hand-off, signing and rollback.
Acceptance criteria: Export access controlled; candidate model benchmarked/signed; rollback tested.

Title: Define pilot criteria and KPIs
Description: Set site entry/exit criteria, measured baseline and rollback conditions.
Acceptance criteria: Covers approval, camera, network, staff, safety, baseline and rollback; no pilot assumed.

Title: Write operator SOP and training
Description: Train alert verification, escalation, false-positive review and evidence retrieval.
Outputs: operator SOP; training checklist; exercise evidence
Acceptance criteria: Scenario drill completed; every enforcement-relevant action remains human-reviewed.

Title: Document support, patching and energy
Description: Define maintenance, backup/restore, rollback, patch, support and power plan.
Acceptance criteria: Restore meets approved local RPO/RTO; rollback tested; energy/cost values labeled assumed/measured.

Title: Complete compliance and adoption review
Description: Record privacy, regulatory, cybersecurity, change and stakeholder reviews.
Acceptance criteria: Reviewers and unresolved obligations recorded; no unsupported legal-compliance claim.

Title: Create one-command demo
Description: Seed synthetic data and inject a deterministic intrusion end-to-end.
Outputs: Makefile; scripts/simulate_intrusion.py; seeds; Compose demo profile
Acceptance criteria: One local command produces labeled synthetic alert/evidence in ≤5 minutes without Internet.

Title: Write run, API, architecture and demo docs
Description: Document clean-machine setup, ports, services, limitations and five-minute flow.
Acceptance criteria: Clean-machine reviewer follows steps; architecture contains PPT-30 flow labeled target; ports and behavior match deployment.

Title: Complete PPT coverage and claim audit
Description: Trace every PPT fact/keyword to task, evidence/test and status.
Acceptance criteria: No registry item blank; unsupported numbers remain attributed/target; self-audit totals reconcile.

Title: Verify references and competition claims
Description: Verify links, source dates, market and competitor attribution; note prototype status.
Acceptance criteria: Each source has URL/access date/use; inaccessible claims marked unverified; no unsupported comparative assertion.

Title: Rehearse submission and offline fallback
Description: Run demo three times and verify backup material, Team ID and claim slides.
Inputs: Demo docs; Team ID placeholder; PPT-01/47
Acceptance criteria: Three timed runs pass; backup works offline; Team ID, licenses, test evidence, risks and metrics checked.
